prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. Kit and Zoe have equal standing height. Include only characters needed by this exact scene, not every reference pose. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: The Door in the Chalk; World Discovery; fiction.
Setting: Explicit fantasy in a classroom art room adjoining a puppet room. One cream dividing wall, ordinary narrow doorway at right, silver chalk that opens unbroken outlined doors into the room beyond.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): Large lightweight hollow paper moon, a round sphere wider than the ordinary doorway; Silver chalk stick; Cream wall between adjacent rooms; Blue puppet curtain in next room; Soft cloth; Plain string used to compare the moon’s width with the doorway
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: Explicit magic; only closed chalk outlines open; ordinary doorway visible to the right.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: Zoe finishes a small closed silver rectangle on a cream wall, revealing a view into the adjacent puppet room. Exact continuity: Explicit magic; only closed chalk outlines open; ordinary doorway visible to the right.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions.
Reference board strictly ISOLATED objects and EMPTY architecture key, no full narrative action. Final artwork finish: perfectly smooth flat-color interiors, no texture or grain anywhere, not even wood/paper/floor. For paper use plain color and crisp outline. Separate views with white space, no letters or labels. Moon is a rigid hollow yellow SPHERE, not flat disk, diameter about Kit torso height and wider than narrow ordinary door. Isolated sphere front/side both circles, silver chalk, soft blue cloth, thin string. Empty location cream dividing wall with narrow wooden doorway at RIGHT to adjacent blue-curtain puppet room. No magical chalk door yet in empty key; initial moon no dent.

visualReview.note: Smooth yellow spherical prop, separate silverchalk/cloth/string and emptyroom with ordinary narrowdoor right; correct cast.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image/sequence inspection; no classroom or physical-device observation.
